p: righteous before me in this generation: In respect to the rest of the world, and because he had a desire to serve God and live uprightly.
clean beast thou shalt take to: Which might be offered in sacrifice, of which six were for breeding and the seventh for sacrifice.
went in two and two unto: God compelled them to present themselves to Noah, as they did before to Adam, when he gave them names, Ge 2:19.
fountains of the great deep broken: Both the waters in the earth overflowed and also the clouds poured down.
of all flesh: Every living thing that God would have be preserved on earth, came into the ark to Noah.
shut him in: So that God's secret power defended him against the rage of the mighty waters.
which was upon the face of: That is, by God.
remained alive: Learn what it is to obey God only, and to forsake the multitude, 1Pe 3:20.
